loops.minute_1: Place first tower (Dart Monkey), kill first bloons, earn starting cash. No upgrade choice yet. Victory condition clear: all bloons dead before reaching end.
loops.minute_10: 2-3 towers placed, first upgrade path selected (3-path constraint). Money is bottleneck. Towers begin synergizing. Player now making strategic choices about economy vs defense.
loops.hour_5: Multiple upgraded towers (tier-3 paths active). Heroes unlock with experience progression. Monkey Knowledge micro-enhancements introduce meta-layer. Optimization for score becomes focus.
loops.endgame: CHIMPS mode: hardcore 1-life run without Monkey Knowledge, power-ups, or tower selling. Pure mechanical mastery. Alternative: Sandbox (infinite waves, freeplay) or New Game+ (veterancy leveling beyond cap 155).

objectives.victory_condition: All bloons defeated before reaching end of path for all 20-50 waves (map-dependent)
objectives.defeat_condition: 1 bloon reaches end = 1 life lost, 4 lives total = game over
objectives.player_goal: Beat all waves, collect stars (higher stars = fewer lives remaining at end)

objectives.victory_condition: All bloons defeated on ultra-hard mode with no power-ups, no Monkey Knowledge, no tower selling
objectives.player_goal: Prove mechanical mastery without safety nets

objectives.defeat_condition: Insufficient cash to defend remaining bloons
objectives.player_goal: Reach as high a wave as possible with given tower setup

games.retention_answer: Three retention loops: (1) mechanical challenge—each 100+ map is a unique puzzle; (2) hero collection—unlock all heroes over weeks; (3) competitive score-attack on leaderboards. New hero unlocks = new viable strategies = previously-impossible maps now beatable.

loops.minute_1: Place Peashooter, sunlight drops from sky. Kill first zombie (Browncoat). Very clear: target on lawn, destroy it. No upgrade complexity. Sunlight generation passive and intuitive.
loops.minute_10: 3-4 plants placed (Peashooter, Sunflower, Walnut, Potato Mine). Manage sunlight economy: wait or spend now? Different plants counter different zombie types. Strategy begins to emerge.
loops.hour_5: 15-20 levels beaten, 15+ plants unlocked. Player optimizes formations by observing zombie spawn patterns per level. Arc shifts from 'kill zombie' to 'predict which lane gets armored zombies'.
loops.endgame: Level 50 boss Dr. Zomboss (pre-planted field, 1 life on center lane = instant loss if breached). Adventure Mode 2 repeats same 50 levels but +50% enemy HP + 3 pre-selected plants per level (less freedom = puzzle).

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat all zombie waves in level before they reach the house (all 50 levels complete = full campaign)
objectives.defeat_condition: 1 zombie reaches house = instant level fail
objectives.player_goal: Clear level with minimal plant losses (3-star = no plant deaths)

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat all waves using only 3 pre-selected plants per level
objectives.defeat_condition: Fail to solve the constraint puzzle within the level limit
objectives.player_goal: Solve constraint puzzle with limited toolset

objectives.defeat_condition: All lawn mowers consumed (no more defenses available)
objectives.player_goal: Survive as many waves as possible without restocking

objectives.victory_condition: Complete puzzle or time-attack objective (varies per mini-game)
objectives.defeat_condition: Zombie reaches house or time expires

games.retention_answer: Two retention loops: (1) collection—40 plants to unlock, each opens new strategy or counters new zombie type; (2) difficulty escalation—each level introduces new zombie forcing player to adapt. Progression is felt as 'unlock counter → strategy viable → hard enemy now easy.' Player returns to unlock next plant and test it on pending levels.

loops.minute_1: Place 1-2 towers (Barracks or Archer), hero spawns. First small wave (3-5 enemies). Test basic tower + hero synergy. Linear, clear path: defend against this wave.
loops.minute_10: 3-4 towers placed (one per type: Barracks, Archer, Mage, Artillery). Hero reaches level 3-4, active ability unlocked. Managing two resource streams: tower upgrades vs hero cooldown-spending. Enemies differentiate (some armor, some flying).
loops.hour_5: 15-20 levels beaten, hero cap (L12) reached, full ability tree extended. New specialized towers unlocked (Reinforcements, Frost Mage). Shift from 'survive' to 'optimize for 3-star (minimize hero deaths)'. Replayability via hero leveling on earlier maps.
loops.endgame: Heroic Challenge (same level, 6 elite waves, 1 life, increased enemy HP) forces hero level cap + optimal tower placement. Iron Challenge (1 super-wave, no breaks, pure execution). No New Game+; endgame is challenge-variant mastery.

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat all 15-20 waves per level before hero reaches 0 HP
objectives.defeat_condition: Hero health reaches 0 = 1 life lost, 3 lives total = level fail
objectives.player_goal: Clear all waves, earn 3-star (maximize hero HP remaining at wave completion)

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat 6 elite waves without hero death (1 life total, increased difficulty)
objectives.player_goal: Master map topology and tower/hero synergy under extreme pressure

objectives.victory_condition: Survive 1 super-wave (all enemies spawn in rapid succession)
objectives.defeat_condition: Fail to place necessary towers in time
objectives.player_goal: Pure execution test of tower placement and timing

games.retention_answer: Three retention loops: (1) hero leveling—each hero to cap L12 unlocks new ability, enabling replay of earlier maps for faster progression; (2) star hunting—minimize hero deaths for mastery signaling; (3) challenge variants—Heroic/Iron teach deep map knowledge and reward skillful play. New hero = new viable strategies = previously-hard level now manageable with new tool.
